Inside Macintosh: OpenDoc Class Reference / Part 2 - Types and Constants

Extensions

The following constants of type ODType (page 876) represent various types for extensions to OpenDoc.
kODExtSemanticInterface
An extension to support a semantic interface in your part.
kODSettingsExtension
An extension to add panels to the Part Info dialog box.
